statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-56109 is a double free in parse_def() in src/conf.c of the ALSA library (alsa-lib) before 1.2.16.1, reached by parsing crafted ALSA configuration text with nested compound or array blocks: parse_def() did not check the return value of get_nonwhite() before deleting the block (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-56109). Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/alsa-project/alsa-lib/commit/536dd6f8affdf5197c12a63a71c92a70b2833cc0, released in 1.2.16.1, and Debian lists trixie's 1.2.14-1+deb13u1 as vulnerable. The DHI Debian repository publishes one alsa-lib build for Debian 13, a rebuild of Debian's 1.2.14-1+deb13u1, on amd64 and arm64, and it applies that upstream commit: the changelog in its libasound2t64 package records the patch on both architectures. We also confirmed the fix in the shipped libasound.so.2 on both architectures, using the matching debug-symbol packages: in parse_defs(), into which parse_def() is inlined, the code after the closing-bracket read now tests the returned character for a negative error code and, if it is one, frees the identifier and returns the error before comparing the character with the expected bracket, a check that Debian's own 1.2.14-1+deb13u1 library lacks on either architecture. Every published build carries the fix, so the range ends at that build.
